question: Which two authentication types does Cisco UCS Manager support when configuring authentication? (Choose two.)
explanation:
Cisco UCS supports two methods to authenticate user logins:
- Through user accounts local to Cisco UCS Manager
- Remotely through one of the following protocols: LDAP, RADIUS, TACACS+
theory: Cisco UCS Manager supports exactly two authentication paths: local accounts stored directly on the UCS Manager database, and remote authentication delegated to an external LDAP, RADIUS, or TACACS+ server. Options like PAM, 802.1X, and Kerberos are not native UCS Manager authentication mechanisms, so only 'local' and 'LDAP' (among the given choices) represent valid UCS authentication types. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 19 - Securing UCS Management Using AAA)
